newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: NatSteel hits new high on funds buying.
newsitem.headline: NatSteel hits new high on funds buying.

text.p: NatSteel Ltd shares hit a new 1997 high of Singapore $3.72 on Tuesday on funds buying, dealers said.
At 0209 GMT, the stock was hovering at S$3.70, up eight cents from its previous close. Total volume was 1.48 million shares, including a block of 450,000 units crossed at S$3.60.
Dealers said the stock is on the buy list of several firms after its successful restructuring.
"It has a good recovery story. They have written off their bad steel investments and they also have NatSteel Electronics which is profitable and should be listed soon," said one dealer.
NatSteel already has a listed electronics subsidiary, NatSteel Broadway.
Last year, the NatSteel group restructured its steel operations in Singapore that resulted in a S$65 million extraordinary loss.
The company reported a stronger than expected 29.6 percent rise in net profit to S$55.5 million for 1996 and said it expected to do better this year.
